general_admission_procedure.description: Multi-step process combining merit in qualifying exams, national-level entrance test scores, and/or the college's own scholarship-based entrance exam (AGC NEST).

steps.title: Check Eligibility & Entrance Exam Requirements
details: Minimum marks required in last qualifying exam (e.g. 50%) - 10+2 for UG, Graduation for PG
Specific subject combination required depending on course (e.g. Physics, Chemistry, Maths for B.Tech)
Accepted entrance exams by course: B.Tech - JEE Main, CUET, or AGC NEST; MBA - CMAT or AGC NEST; other UG courses - AGC NEST
For B.Voc, D.Pharmacy, PG courses and lateral entry (LEET), admission is often based solely on qualifying exam marks with no separate entrance exam, but online registration is mandatory

steps.title: Application / Registration
details: Conducted online through the official AGC admissions portal
Candidate registers and fills personal details, academic information, and program choice
If applying through AGC NEST, candidate pays a registration fee of approximately Rs. 500 and selects a test slot

steps.title: Appear for Entrance Exam (if applicable)
details: AGC NEST: short online MCQ test (approx. 45 minutes); scholarship is typically declared immediately and used for both selection and scholarship purposes
National/State exams (JEE Main, CMAT, CUET): candidate must have a valid scorecard meeting the college's cut-off marks

steps.title: Counselling and Document Verification
details: Shortlisted candidates attend a counselling session (online via video conferencing, or offline)
Final selection and seat allocation is based on merit (entrance exam score or qualifying exam marks)

Documents required for verification: Class 10th and 12th mark sheets and certificates, Graduation mark sheet and certificate (for PG), Entrance exam scorecard (JEE/CMAT/CUET/AGC NEST), Transfer/Migration certificate, Character certificate, Aadhaar card/ID proof, Caste certificate and Income certificate (if applicable)

steps.title: Seat Confirmation and Fee Payment
details: Once documents are verified and seat is allocated, candidate receives a provisional admission letter
Candidate must pay first-semester/annual course fees to confirm and secure the allotted seat

Admission advertised in regional newspapers (Punjabi, Hindi, English) and on college website www.agcamritsar.in

Students register for AGC NEST (National Entrance Scholarship Test) with a fee of Rs. 500 (excluding college prospectus)
After clearing the entrance test, student becomes eligible for admission along with scholarship
Counseling schedule notified based on JEE, 12th marks, and AGC NEST ranks by Department of CCIE
Fee and documents must be submitted within 15 days from declaration of entrance exam results and AGC NEST scholarship amount
Fee payable via Cash, Cheque, Demand Draft, or UPI
Student admitted provisionally after fee and document submission
Department of CCIE schedules 3 to 4 counseling rounds to fill seats

rules: Upgradation process carried out prior to commencement of 3rd semester, based on 1st and 2nd semester results
Only students who cleared all subjects of 1st and 2nd semester in B.Tech can participate
Dean CCIE invites applications from eligible students with a specified last date; date/time of upgradation notified on college notice boards
Last date to submit applications must be at least 2 days before the upgradation date
Merit list prepared based on 1st and 2nd semester results and displayed on notice board once results are declared
Branch upgradation takes place only after an official notification is issued by the University
Branch-wise seat availability is notified and displayed on the notice board
On the date of upgradation, applicants are called in order of merit
A student absent at the time of upgradation loses their chance and has no claim to the converted seat
Signed upgradation record (by Principal/Director) is notified on notice boards, and a copy sent to the University for approval the next working day
notes: Upgradation of branch takes precedence over Intra University and Inter University migration
Upgradation is done only based on availability of seats in the particular course

rules: Migration from another college within the University allowed only after completion of 1st year, and only for students eligible to register for 3rd semester
Migration allowed after completion of 2nd semester but before start of 3rd semester
Candidates cannot change their discipline of study during migration
order_of_preference: Branch upgradation (if applicable) carried out at college level based on 1st and 2nd semester results
Merit based on combined 1st and 2nd semester marks forms the basis of migration
Preference given to students who cleared all subjects of the first year
intra_university_migration_procedure: Both the current institute and the institute migration is sought to must issue a No Objection Certificate (NOC)
Student must submit a signed written application along with NOCs from both colleges
University authorizes migration only against a vacant seat in the discipline sought
Migration additionally governed by rules of the concerned college, if applicable

migration_from_other_universities.condition: Allowed 15 days prior to start of 3rd semester, for students migrating from other recognized universities
requirements: Candidate must have passed all first-year courses at the university they are migrating from
First-year courses studied must be equivalent to those offered at this University; supplementary subjects (if any) should not exceed two
Candidate must furnish an undertaking to attend classes and pass any deficient courses
Both institutes and universities involved must have no objection to the migration
A vacant seat must be available in the discipline sought
Migration additionally governed by rules of the concerned University

notes: Branch shifting within college as per merit under PTU rules takes precedence over Intra/Inter University migration
Intra-University migration is given preference over Inter-University migration
